Ramon Jefferson Verano, chief of the Special Projects Section of the Manila Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO), shows thermal drone images of the Navotas Sanitary Landfill, which remains ablaze and continues to release unhealthy air affecting nearby cities on Tuesday, April 21. Authorities are closely monitoring the situation as efforts to suppress the fire continue. 

📸: Mark Balmores/MB

Members of transport group MANIBELA, alongside PISTON and various militant groups, stage a protest in front of a gas station along Commonwealth Avenue on Tuesday, April 21, continuing their call on the government to suspend the excise tax on fuel and abolish the oil deregulation law to help public transport drivers and the general public cope with rising fuel prices amid tensions in the Middle East. 

📸: Santi San Juan/MB
